_comment: The fixed string set for the font-metrics check (SPEC section 7). Read by tools/gen_text_probe.py, which generates the scene the app draws, and by tools/verify_text.py, which computes what that scene must look like -- so the two can never drift. Boxes are game pixels; anchor 0/1/2 = upper left/centre/right.

strings.why: Big is monospaced, and its letters carry a 2 px vertical bearing its digits do not
proportional advances, right-aligned, and the only punctuation any face has
centre alignment rounds in game pixels, not device pixels
parentheses have no glyph and are skipped entirely (ADR 10); the line break advances by lineSpacing
inverted text: the box paints ink and the glyphs paint the field colour
